rules.text: Only a clean public artifact counts.
rules.evidence: A target counts only when its page answers with every file.
A plan for other work is refused while a repair is open.
A step with no why is not refused.

rules.text: A call on the never list is stopped.
rules.evidence: Checked in code before the call goes out.

rules.text: Its own writes go only to tools/<tool>/.
rules.evidence: Checked in code before the call goes out.

rules.text: A new version is a commit to its own folder.
